newsitem.title: IRAQ: PRESS DIGEST - Iraq - April May 1.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Iraq - April May 1.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Iraqi press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Saddam Hussein receives more congratulations on his 60th birthday.
- Iraq calls for the preservation of Arab rights in waters.
- Oil conference in Nicosia demands lifting of sanctions on both Libya and Iraq.
- Russia expects deterioration of relations with the United States.
- Iranian resistance welcomes EU decision to halt dialogue with Tehran on ministerial level.
- Iraq and Turkey discuss boosting border trade.
- Deputy Prime Minister Tareq Aziz receives Jordanian personality.
- National Assembly speaker receives Arab parliamentarian.
(The above were also carried by AL-QADISSIYA and AL-IRAQ)
- Editorial blasts U.S. policy of dual containment.
- Article on the role played by Saddam in leading the country.
- Article on link between Islam and Arabs as a nation.
